faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) under the Centre for Community Medicine for a temporary project position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi has advertised the post of Staff Nurse Equivalent to Project Nurse-III under advertisement number N-2380/SEPT/01 for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Staff Nurse Equivalent to Project Nurse-III position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse Equivalent to Project Nurse-III post is 10-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four-year nursing course along with relevant work experience of at least two years in a clinical discipline within a hospital environment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years, with permissible age relaxations applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Staff Nurse Equivalent to Project Nurse-III position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28000/- plus admissible HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or mentioned in the official notification released by AIIMS Delhi for this particular post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves the short-listing of eligible candidates followed by an interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the Google application form provided via the official application link before the deadline.
